framework_rationale: The solution legitimately uses TensorCircuit (tc.set_backend('jax'), tc.set_dtype('complex128'), tc.DMCircuit2, tc.gates.Gate, tc.gates.h/cnot/x/rxx/z, apply_general_gate, apply_general_kraus, and expectation with reuse=False) for all quantum circuit construction, noisy Kraus channel simulation, and observable evaluation. JAX, NumPy, and Optax are used solely as TensorCircuit's autodiff/JIT backend, array conversion layer, and Adam optimizer. No other quantum framework is imported or used.
cheating_rationale: There is no hardcoding of target outputs or hidden answers, no tampering with tests or reward files, and no exploitation of evaluator weaknesses. Synthetic target observables are generated from config['true_p01'] and config['true_p10'] using the exact same noisy probe circuit function, while optimization starts strictly from config['initial_p01'] and config['initial_p10'] and recovers the channel probabilities via gradient descent through the TensorCircuit density-matrix simulation.
fidelity_rationale: The implementation faithfully matches every requirement of Problem 4: it constructs the three specified Kraus operators K0, K1, K2 as tc.gates.Gate objects; prepares the four required 12-qubit probe states (GHZ, Bell-like (|01>+|10>)/sqrt(2) pairs, |0>^n, and |+>^n); applies the even-bond and odd-bond brickwork layers of RXX(theta) = exp(-i theta X_i X_j / 2) followed by independent per-qubit Kraus noise on both qubits of each bond; computes the (4, 13) table of single-site <Z_i> and full-chain parity <Z_0...Z_11> expectations; parameterizes p01 and p10 via sigmoid of unconstrained logits initialized from config['initial_p01'] and config['initial_p10']; runs exactly config['max_steps'] (120) Adam updates at config['learning_rate'] (0.04) on MSE loss without early stopping while recording each pre-update loss; and returns the required NumPy arrays under loss_history, final_probabilities, and fitted_expectations without printing progress.
implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation errors were found. Matrix entries of K0, K1, K2 match the transition directions (0->1 with p01, 1->0 with p10) and satisfy completeness to machine precision; bond indexing covers (0,1)...(10,11) and (1,2)...(9,10); tc.gates.rxx matches the exp(-i theta XX / 2) convention; and the optimization loop cleanly evaluates pre-update loss and final post-update expectations.
